rationale: The NASA presentation formalizes a Simplex-style architecture in which a black-box advanced controller may be used only under safe-state, monitor/switch timing and trusted reversionary-controller premises. The claim describes that conditional theorem form and does not claim a monitor can observe every perception miss. The stated occluded-conflict counterexample is therefore a valid challenge to any unqualified rescue claim, not a contradiction of the conditional formalization.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-005-R1, NASA 'A Verification Framework for Runtime Assurance of Autonomous UAS', PDF pp. 5-8
S-EVID-005-R2, NASA framework premises and productive-conflict-avoidance example, PDF pp. 8-12
limitations: This is a formal research presentation, not civil approval or an implementation audit, and it is not independent from the related NASA/Plaidypvs method family already in the registry.
The worked case has not established independent sensing, monitor latency, switch timing, dynamics bounds, recovery authority, or correlated-failure behavior.
